name: 92881 · Corona, CA
findings: ZIP 92881 (Corona) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92881 (Corona) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92881 (Corona) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
